dify_app.name: Bettermode Marketplace Creator Agent
dify_app.description: Drafts admin replies for posts in the Webflow Community Marketplace Creators space, grounded in the Marketplace policy knowledge base and the bettermode-creator MCP. Consumed by the Cloudflare Worker at apps/bettermode-marketplace-creator-agent via the chat-messages API.

tools.name: fetch_post_thread
tools.description: Fetch a Marketplace Creator post by Bettermode post ID and return body + reply thread + author + space.

tools.name: get_creator_context
tools.description: Look up a Webflow Marketplace Creator by email in Airtable; return record + linked Assets/templates.

tools.name: list_recent_approved_drafts
tools.description: Return the most recent admin replies sent via this agent. Used as few-shot voice examples.

tools.name: get_draft_status
tools.description: Audit lookup: return whether a draft already exists for a post and its current status.

knowledge_base.name: Webflow Marketplace Policy

datasets.name: Submission Guidelines
datasets.source: Submission Guidelines Updates V2.md (internal; supersedes published guidelines on conflict)

knowledge_base.binding_note: Datasets are workspace-scoped in Dify and cannot be bound through the imported YAML. After importing the .dify.yml in Studio, manually attach both datasets under the agent app's Knowledge tab. retrieval top_k = 5, reranking enabled.

consumers.failure_mode: If Dify is unreachable or DIFY_AGENT_API_KEY is unset, the worker skips draft creation rather than generating an ungrounded reply.

import_instructions: 1. In Dify Studio, Studio → Create new app → 'Import from DSL file' and upload bettermode-marketplace-creator-agent.dify.yml.
2. After import, attach the 'Submission Guidelines' and 'Grading Rubric' datasets to the agent under the Knowledge tab. Set top_k = 5 and reranking enabled.
3. Confirm the bettermode-creator MCP is authorized under Tools → MCP. All 4 tools should be selected on the agent.
4. Confirm model is gpt-5.4 (workspace-approved). Adjust temperature if drafts feel too uniform.
5. Publish the app and create a Service API key from API Access.
6. Store the Service API key in Infisical under WEBFLOW_DIFY_AGENT_API_KEY (env=dev).
8. The worker auto-uses Dify on the next webhook (no redeploy required).
agent_prompt: See pre_prompt block in bettermode-marketplace-creator-agent.dify.yml — the prompt is the single source of truth and is imported with the YAML.
